svg.title: The Mount of Olives — Woodward/Cousen historical steel-engraving artmaster
svg.desc: Source-derived local burin/contour tracing from the verified public-domain 1881-84 Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives steel engraving. Ancient olive trees, Kidron valley slopes, stone walls and Jerusalem skyline are all from the actual engraved image, not procedural substitute silhouettes. Independent editorial crop for mobile.
svg.metadata: Woodward, John Douglas (1846–1924), original art; Cousen, Charles (1819–1889), steel engraver; 1881–1884, Picturesque Palestine, Sinai and Egypt. NYPL Image ID 80257; Wikimedia Commons: Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives (NYPL b10607452-80257).jpg. Original public-domain artwork; mechanically scanned public-domain reproduction. Sha1: 8097a8aa1e5c1ee4ef0bcd126578b73d89229f04. Digitally traced to SVG via Pillow source-derived burin and contours via Potrace. Ink coverage 0.10429/0.06046.
